```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a system administrator
  I want the system to trigger alarms for battery failure, high blower motor temperature, high blower power management system temperature, and high battery temperature
  So that I can take necessary actions to prevent damage to the system

  Scenario: Battery failure alarm has high priority
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery fails
    Then the "battery failure" alarm is triggered with high priority

  Scenario: System can sense temperature of heating elements
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor, blower power management system, and battery cell are operating
    Then the system can sense the temperature of each heating element

  Scenario: GUI can read temperature sensors
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the GUI is connected to the temperature sensors
    Then the GUI can read the temperature of the blower motor, blower power management system, and battery cell

  Scenario: Blower motor temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower motor temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "blower motor temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Blower power management system temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower power management system temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "blower power system temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Battery temperature too high alarm
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "battery temperature too high" alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Automatic safety action for blower power system temperature
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the blower power management system temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the system automatically invokes a safety action

  Scenario: Automatic safety action for battery temperature
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the battery temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the system automatically invokes a safety action

  Scenario Outline: Alarms triggered by user-specified thresholds
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <heating_element> temperature exceeds the user-specified threshold
    Then the "<alarm_name>" alarm is triggered
    Examples:
      | heating_element | alarm_name      |
      | blower motor    | blower motor temperature too high |
      | blower power management system | blower power system temperature too high |
      | battery cell    | battery temperature too high |

  Scenario Outline: Alarms triggered by user-specified thresholds - edge cases
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <heating_element> temperature is equal to the user-specified threshold
    Then the "<alarm_name>" alarm is not triggered
    Examples:
      | heating_element | alarm_name      |
      | blower motor    | blower motor temperature too high |
      | blower power management system | blower power system temperature too high |
      | battery cell    | battery temperature too high |

  Scenario Outline: Alarms triggered by user-specified thresholds - invalid values
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <heating_element> temperature is less than 0
    Then the "<alarm_name>" alarm is not triggered
    Examples:
      | heating_element | alarm_name      |
      | blower motor    | blower motor temperature too high |
      | blower power management system | blower power system temperature too high |
      | battery cell    | battery temperature too high |
```
